title: File:Chamonix valley from la Flégère,2010 07.JPG
claims: The Commons file shows the Chamonix valley and the Mont Blanc massif as seen from la Flégère, with the town in the valley below.
The file is a landscape photograph of the TDS finish valley, not a photograph of the TDS race; it contains no runners or event signage.
The author is Ximonic, Simo Räsänen, credited under CC BY-SA 3.0; the original file is 3,750 x 2,500 pixels, 9,965,263 bytes, dated 2010-07-31.
The file page requires attribution and share-alike; the route page uses a 960 x 640 Commons thumbnail of 208,724 bytes and credits the author and licence.
